items.prompt: Pitch-black outer space with a few bright golden stars. In the centre, a long narrow golden ticket floats upright, formed from a spiral of gathering light particles: polished gold foil with fine engraved ornament borders and, in its middle, an engraved picture of an old slender rocket. The ticket glows softly. Lower third dark and calm.

The bottom of a deep round vertical shaft under a golden temple, seen from the bottom of a long spiral stone staircase that winds down its wall. In the middle of the shaft stands a tall slender OLD rocket of riveted bronze and brass, its whole hull covered densely with many different engraved planet and star emblems. White steam billows around its base. A shaft of light falls from far above. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside an old brass rocket cabin: a large round porthole window framed in riveted brass and dark wood fills the upper middle; outside the window, pitch-black outer space full of stars. Warm dim cabin lights, a few floating dust motes as if weightless. A blank smooth pale wall panel on one side. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside an old brass rocket cabin: a large round porthole window framed in riveted brass; outside, a huge bright white Moon fills most of the window, very close, its craters sharp, against black space. Warm dim cabin light. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside an old brass rocket cabin: a large round porthole window framed in riveted brass; outside, the planet Saturn with its enormous golden rings approaches, glowing amber against black space full of stars. Warm dim cabin light. Lower third calm and simple.

A plain of fine white sand on the Moon under a pitch-black sky. High in the sky, a small brilliant blue Earth. On the sand, an old slender bronze rocket covered in engraved planet emblems has just landed, steam curling. Next to it stands a serene temple of white stone with slender columns and a dome, softly lit in silver and gold. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside a serene temple of white marble on the Moon: slender white columns, silver and pale gold ornament, a tall arched window showing the black sky with a small blue Earth. On the floor in the centre, a large round shallow basin of still water, glowing faintly, its rim carved with star patterns. A single soft pillar of white-gold light falls from the ceiling just behind the basin (empty inside). Lower third calm and simple.

A small white marble altar deep inside a Moon temple, lit by a soft pillar of light. On the altar sit two smooth pearly eggs side by side on little silver stands, one with faint gold veins, one with faint silver veins. Quiet, sacred, warm glow. Lower third calm and simple.

Night inside a white marble Moon temple: a large arched window showing a big glowing blue Earth in the black sky full of stars. Soft blue moonlight on the floor and cushions, a gently glowing round water basin, very peaceful and sleepy. Lower third calm and simple.

Pitch-black space with golden light particles. In the centre floats one old thick leather-bound book with worn brass corners and a brass clasp, its cover embossed with eight small circular seals arranged in a ring around a compass-like emblem. Golden light seeps from between its pages. Lower third dark and calm.

Close-up of an open cupped hand in a black glove (the hand of a hooded figure in a black robe, edge of frame) holding a small smooth translucent gemstone the size of a walnut. Inside the stone, a soft warm light slowly swirls like liquid sunlight, glowing gold and pale blue. Dark golden background with bokeh. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside a white marble Moon temple, a soft pillar of white-gold light. Two small smooth round devices, each the size of a palm, gently descend through the light: sleek polished pearl-white orbs with a thin glowing blue band around the middle and a tiny lens. Floating sparkles. Lower third calm and simple.

On the surface of Saturn: an enormous golden ring arches across the whole sky. Beneath it stands a gaudy, over-the-top flashy golden temple, everything covered in gold leaf and gems, its roofs shaped like giant round takoyaki balls topped with gold, glowing lanterns everywhere. Tacky but magnificent, funny, amber and gold light. Lower third calm and simple.

Inside a gaudy flashy golden temple on Saturn, gold everywhere, red lanterns. In the middle of the hall, a big black iron takoyaki griddle with rows of round hollows, steam rising from it, warm cosy light. Through a high window the golden rings of Saturn. Lower third calm and simple.

Looking up at the sky of Saturn: deep indigo and violet sky, the vast golden rings of Saturn sweep across it in a big arc, glittering with countless tiny particles. Below, the gold rooftops of a temple with takoyaki-shaped domes at the very bottom edge. Dreamy and open, plenty of empty sky. Lower third calm and simple.

Night on Saturn: wide stone steps of a golden temple, tall pillars, lanterns glowing softly. Overhead, the enormous rings of Saturn turn slowly across a starry sky, very far away a tiny moving speck of light on the farthest edge of the rings. Quiet, wistful, beautiful. Lower third calm and simple.

On a dark golden table, an opened thick letter of cream paper sealed with a big green wax seal shaped like a daikon radish with leaves. The paper is filled with huge bold brush-ink strokes (abstract, illegible, no actual characters). Warm lantern light, gold sparkles. Lower third calm and simple.
